name: legacycore__member__get_savings_balance
description: Get a member's savings balance. Looks up a member by member number and reads the current balance of their share savings account and the member's name. Returns status 'succeeded' with outputs: savings_balance (money), member_name (string); or status 'business_outcome' with one of: ACCESS_RESTRICTED, MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, NO_SAVINGS_ACCOUNT; or status 'failed' with a failure code and whether retrying can help. Side effects: reversible. Version 1.0.3.
